name: attr-bounded
description: Pointwise+reduction vocabulary with attribute-VALUE bounds (vocab.attr_values, T-028): reduction heads must spell an edge dim (softmax/log_softmax/sum dim=-1, amax dim in {-1, 1} — the dim=0 spelling fails), view unsqueezes stay on dims 0/1, and clamp sites must carry the nonnegative min=0.0/max=1.0 spelling — the symmetric ±1.0 clamp the corpus also emits fails the per-case post-filter.  Demo for the attr-values gap: name whitelists could not express this.
